onboarding.Business case summary: Minerds Bell is a South Australia based financial advisory firm with over 50 years of history, led by Andrew Harris (Principal) alongside directors Natalie Bordun and Daran Thompson. The firm employs five financial advisers, one practice manager, two paraplanners, and five administrative staff. North is the preferred investment platform. The current operational model averages 15 investments per client, creating implementation risk and administrative burden. The proposal is to form an investment sales partnership to build two Built portfolios (0% growth / 100% growth) to improve efficiency. Expected inflows are $35 million with an overall committed FUA to SMA of $300 million over two years. Dollar committed: $100m existing + $30m new. Profitable in 12 months: Yes. Manager: Salita. SMA Product Offer: Build. RE Fee (exclusive of GST): 0.10%. Scorecard Rating: 65% Pass. Approved by Dipin Arora, Head of Investment Menus & SMA, AMP North.
